messages:
Alex: 08:07 UTC Opening thread - activations in eu-west showing "processing assets" hangs. Notifying CS for customer outreach. See INC-4460 internally.

Marta: Support queue: 22 stuck activations, 5 marked renewal-risk (next 45d). Most stop at schema validation.

Ken: Short root cause: a tighter schema check deployed this morning increased validation latency; under parallel uploads we hit a DB contention. Rolled a soft rollback at 08:30 UTC which stopped new failures.

Sophie: Mitigations done: scaled workers + enabled object-store fallback for uploads. Backlog draining; current throughput ~9 activations/min. ETA ~4-6 hours depending on retries. Prioritizing dedicated/reserved tenants.

Alex: Customer comms plan (send by 09:00 UTC): one-line status + ETA, link to status page, two EU-friendly office hours, and a goodwill credit + enablement offer. Also include a 1-question feedback link to capture renewal sentiment. Draft below.

Alex: Draft msg: "Hi <Customer>, were investigating a tenant activation issue in EU causing some setups to stall at processing. Weve applied mitigations and expect most activations to finish within 4-6 hours. Were prioritizing enterprise and near-term renewals. Office hours: 09:30 & 15:30 CET. Reply to request a 1:1. One-time account credit + free enablement session offered. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-4460"

Marta: I'll send personalized notes to the 5 enterprise contacts and bulk to the rest. Will tag any replies that mention renewal delays.

Ken: I'll produce RCA sketch by EOD and add canary tests + an alert for activation-hang > 3min.

Sophie: Impacted tenant list exported (22 tenants) and shared to Alex/Marta via secure link. Tagged renewal quarters.

ops-bot: Incident INC-4460 update: mitigations partial, backlog draining. Next auto-update 09:30 UTC.

Alex: Thanks team. Keep replies brief in-thread for CS to paste into customer replies. If anyone signals churn risk, escalate to AEs immediately.

Marta: Bulk send started 08:58 UTC. Two customers already requested 1:1s; flagged high-priority.

Sophie: Backlog improving to ~12/min. Will update if regression occurs.

Alex: Closing operational coordination here; continue posting customer responses and renewal flags in this thread.
